history2.fixtures__balls.fixture_id: Unique identifier of the cricket match.
history2.fixtures__balls.team__id: ⚠️ NUMERIC team identifier (NOT team name). Use with scoreboard filter.
history2.fixtures__balls.scoreboard: Choose S1 for Bowling team and S2 for Batting/Chasing team.
history2.fixtures__balls.batsman_id: Unique identifier of batsman at striker end.
history2.fixtures__balls.ball: Ball number in the innings (decimal format, e.g., 5.3 for 5th over, 3rd ball).
history2.fixtures__balls.score__runs: Runs scored on this ball (0-6+). ⚠️ NOT 'score' or 'runs'
history2.fixtures__balls.score__is_wicket: Indicates if wicket fell (0 or 1). ⚠️ NOT 'is_wicket'
history2.fixtures__balls.❌ NO 'overs': Use ball instead, or join to fixtures__runs for overs
history2.fixtures__balls.❌ NO 'wickets': Use score__is_wicket for individual balls, or join to fixtures__runs for total

history2.fixtures__batting.fixture_id: Unique identifier of the cricket match.
history2.fixtures__batting.team_id: ⚠️ NUMERIC team identifier (NOT team name). Use with scoreboard filter.
history2.fixtures__batting.scoreboard: S2 for batting team and S1 for bowling team.
history2.fixtures__batting.player_id: Batsman ID. ⚠️ Use player_id NOT player__id
history2.fixtures__batting.ball: Ball number when this batting stat was recorded.
history2.fixtures__batting.rate: Batting strike rate. ⚠️ Verify exists in schema
history2.fixtures__batting.❌ NO 'batsman__fullname': Join to fixtures__balls for batsman names

history2.fixtures__bowling.fixture_id: Unique identifier of the cricket match.
history2.fixtures__bowling.team_id: ⚠️ NUMERIC team identifier (NOT team name). Use with scoreboard filter.
history2.fixtures__bowling.scoreboard: S1 for bowling team and S2 for batting team.
history2.fixtures__bowling.wickets: Wickets taken by bowler till that over.
history2.fixtures__bowling.❌ NO 'bowler__fullname': CRITICAL: Join to fixtures__balls for bowler names!
history2.fixtures__bowling.❌ NO 'batsman_id': Join to fixtures__balls for batsman information
history2.fixtures__bowling.❌ NO 'score': Use 'runs' for runs conceded in this table

history2.fixtures__runs.fixture_id: Unique identifier of the cricket match.
history2.fixtures__runs.team_id: ⚠️ NUMERIC team identifier (NOT team name). Use with scoreboard filter.
history2.fixtures__runs.inning: Choose inning = 2 for chasing/batting team and inning = 1 for bowling/defending team. ⚠️ ONLY in fixtures__runs, NOT in fixtures__balls. inning 2 is same as scoreboard S2
history2.fixtures__runs.❌ NO 'batsman__fullname': Join to fixtures__balls for player names
history2.fixtures__runs.❌ NO 'bowler__fullname': Join to fixtures__balls for player names
history2.fixtures__runs.❌ NO 'ball': Use 'overs' in this table for total overs
